revenue.source: Merck 10-K FY2025 (acc. 0000310158-26-000063) sales; stockanalysis.com MRK income statement

operating_income.source: Derived: Income before taxes + Other (income) expense, net from 10-K consolidated statement of income (FY2025: 21,067+151; FY2024: 19,936-24; FY2023: 1,889+466). Merck does not report operating income; FY2023 depressed by Prometheus/IPR&D charges.

d_and_a.source: stockanalysis.com MRK cash flow statement (D&A line, excludes accelerated restructuring depreciation: $1.2B in 2025, $254M in 2024, $140M in 2023, per 10-K). Not directly verified against filing cash flow statement.

capex.source: Merck 10-K cash flow statement, capital expenditures (FY2025 acc. 0000310158-26-000063; FY2024 acc. 0001628280-25-007732)

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2026 supported by new launches (Winrevair, Ohtuvayre via Verona acquisition) and Keytruda strength; 2027 moderate growth with >$2B generic/LOE headwinds per company commentary; Keytruda US patent expiry ~2028 creates drag in FY2029, partly offset by pipeline.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: GAAP-derived EBIT margin was 32.6% in FY2025 and 31.0% in FY2024; held ~33% assuming restructuring costs normalise offset by LOE pressure and ongoing R&D investment.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: effective rate 13.3% FY2025 and 14.1% FY2024 (stockanalysis.com); set slightly higher for global minimum tax / US policy risk.

da_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 D&A 4,638 / 65,011 = 7.1%; Verona intangibles amortisation supports this level.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 capex 6.3% of sales; 10-K says ~$20B capital projects planned 2025-2029 (~$4B/yr, ~6% of sales).

wacc.source: Assumption: large-cap pharma, low beta (~0.4-0.6), risk-free ~4.3%, ERP ~5%, with leverage after debt-funded acquisitions; ~7.5% rounded. Not taken from a data provider.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below long-run nominal GDP; conservative given patent-cliff exposure.

net_debt.source: Total debt (loans payable + long-term debt) carrying value $49.3B at 12/31/2025 per 10-K FY2025 fair-value note, minus cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash of 14,690 (stock-analysis-on.net cash flow statement). Short-term investments at 12/31/2025 NOT FOUND (was 447 at 12/31/2024) and balance-sheet cash excl. restricted cash not retrieved; net debt may be slightly overstated. Reviewer should verify.

diluted_shares.source: Weighted average diluted shares FY2025, 2,507 million (stockanalysis.com MRK income statement; consistent with 10-K GAAP EPS $7.28 on net income $18.25B)
